name: The Tower at Boca Raton
positioning: Tower at The Boca Raton: a Rockwell Group-designed hotel within The Boca Raton resort, with Atlantic Ocean and coastline views and steps from Harborside Pool Club
best_for: Families and groups who want suites that can be connected or combined into a whole floor
Travelers who want ocean-view rooms steps from a resort pool club

facts.text: The Boca Raton is essentially five hotels on one property, and Tower is one of them.
Tower is steps away from Harborside's restaurants and Harborside Pool Club.
Tower was designed by Rockwell Group, with a coastal theme, custom palm leaf-inspired carpets and warm wood accents.
Tower's rooms and suites have warm wood accents and views of the Atlantic Ocean and the South Florida coastline.
Built-in window seating in Tower's rooms emphasizes the views, alongside Floridian-inspired artwork.
The Tower lounge offers complimentary refreshments, coffee and pastries.
Top of the Tower was once home to Chef Gordon Ramsay's first North American outpost.
Tower's signature amenities include access to the private amenities of The Boca Raton Club.
Tower's signature amenities include Molton Brown bath amenities and a Nespresso coffee maker.
The 2024 MICHELIN Guide awarded Tower at The Boca Raton a MICHELIN Key.
Japanese Bocce Club, a preferred dining venue for Tower guests, combines traditional Japanese cuisine with a modern, playful spirit.
Sadelle's sits near the entrance to Tower and serves breakfast and lunch classics, including its bagels.

highlights.text: Suite Collection guests have access to Top of the Tower, a private lounge on the 27th floor with views of the Atlantic Ocean and the South Florida coastline.
Tower's all-suite floors can be configured to guests' needs, from grouping connecting suites to taking over an entire floor, for groups and families.
Harborside Pool Club, just steps from Tower, has three pools, a lazy river, two water slides and cabanas with personal butler service.
Top of the Tower has vintage artwork, curated Assouline books and classic telescopes.
Tower Suite Collection guests get a complimentary breakfast buffet, lunch and dinner bites, and drinks at Top of the Tower.

considerations.text: Top of the Tower access and its complimentary food and drinks are Suite Collection benefits.
The resort's private beachfront is across Lake Boca Raton from the Harborside location, and water taxis carry guests between them.
WhataHotel notes luxury pricing that reflects premium positioning.
